name: Hampi
description: Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage Site located in the Vijayanagara district. It was the capital of the Vijayanagara Empire in the 14th century. Its boulder-strewn landscape hides more than 1,600 surviving monuments, including temples, palaces, markets and stepwells along the Tungabhadra river.
history: Founded around 1336 by Harihara and Bukka, Vijayanagara grew into one of the richest cities in the world, visited by Persian and Portuguese travellers who described its bazaars full of gems. At its peak under Krishnadevaraya the city covered about 40 square kilometres. After the Battle of Talikota in 1565 the city was plundered for months and abandoned, leaving behind the ruins that visitors explore today.
food: Banana pancakes at Hampi Bazaar cafes
how_to_reach: Hosapete railway station is 13 km away. Overnight trains and KSRTC buses connect Bengaluru (340 km) to Hosapete. Hire an auto, bicycle or moped to move between ruins.
tips: Start early to avoid the afternoon heat, carry water and wear comfortable footwear. Hire a licensed guide at Vittala Temple for the full story.
summary_kn: ಹಂಪಿ ವಿಜಯನಗರ ಸಾಮ್ರಾಜ್ಯದ ರಾಜಧಾನಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದ ಯುನೆಸ್ಕೋ ವಿಶ್ವ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ತಾಣ; ವಿರೂಪಾಕ್ಷ ದೇವಾಲಯ, ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ರಥ ಮತ್ತು ಕಮಲ ಮಹಲ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆಗಳು.
summary_hi: हम्पी विजयनगर साम्राज्य की राजधानी रहा यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल है; विरुपाक्ष मंदिर, पत्थर का रथ और लोटस महल यहाँ के मुख्य आकर्षण हैं।

name: Mysore Palace
description: The Amba Vilas Palace, better known as Mysore Palace, is the official residence of the Wadiyar dynasty and one of India's most visited monuments. Its Indo-Saracenic architecture, stained-glass ceilings and the Durbar Hall are spectacular, and on Sundays and festival evenings the palace is lit by nearly 100,000 bulbs.
history: The current palace was designed by British architect Henry Irwin and completed in 1912 after the old wooden palace burned down in 1897. It is the centre of the world-famous Mysuru Dasara celebrations, when the golden howdah procession (Jamboo Savari) starts from the palace grounds.
how_to_reach: Mysuru is 145 km from Bengaluru by road (about 3 hours) and well connected by frequent trains such as the Shatabdi and Vande Bharat. The palace is in the city centre.
tips: Visit on a Sunday evening (7:00 - 7:45 PM) to see the illumination. Footwear must be deposited at the counter before entering.
summary_kn: ಒಡೆಯರ್ ರಾಜವಂಶದ ಭವ್ಯ ಮೈಸೂರು ಅರಮನೆ ದಸರಾ ಹಬ್ಬದ ಕೇಂದ್ರ; ಭಾನುವಾರ ಸಂಜೆ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ದೀಪಗಳಿಂದ ಬೆಳಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary_hi: वाडियार राजवंश का भव्य मैसूर पैलेस दशहरा उत्सव का केंद्र है; रविवार शाम को यह हज़ारों बल्बों से जगमगाता है।

name: Badami
description: Badami, the ancient Vatapi, is famous for its four rock-cut cave temples carved into red sandstone cliffs above the Agastya Lake. The caves contain beautiful sculptures of Shiva as Nataraja, Vishnu and Jain tirthankaras.
history: Badami was the capital of the Early Chalukyas from 540 to 757 CE. King Pulakeshin II ruled from here and defeated Harshavardhana on the banks of the Narmada. The cave temples were carved in the 6th century and are among the earliest examples of Chalukyan architecture.
how_to_reach: Badami has a railway station 5 km from town on the Hubballi - Vijayapura line. It is about 450 km from Bengaluru and 105 km from Hubballi. Combine it with Aihole and Pattadakal.
tips: Watch your belongings - monkeys are active near the caves. Late afternoon light on the red cliffs is great for photos.
summary_kn: ಚಾಲುಕ್ಯರ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ ಬಾದಾಮಿ ಕೆಂಪು ಮರಳುಗಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆತ್ತಿದ ಗುಹಾ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಗಸ್ತ್ಯ ಸರೋವರಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: चालुक्यों की राजधानी बादामी लाल बलुआ पत्थर में तराशे गुफा मंदिरों और अगस्त्य झील के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Aihole
description: Aihole is called the cradle of Indian temple architecture. More than 120 stone temples from the 5th to 12th centuries are spread across the village, with the apsidal Durga Temple being the most striking.
history: Aihole served as an experimental ground for Chalukyan architects who tried out new temple forms here before building at Pattadakal. The Ravikirti inscription of 634 CE at the Meguti Jain temple records the victories of Pulakeshin II.
how_to_reach: Aihole is 35 km from Badami and 14 km from Pattadakal. Hire a taxi or auto from Badami to cover all three sites in one day.
tips: Food options are limited in the village, so carry snacks and water.
summary_kn: ಐಹೊಳೆಯನ್ನು ಭಾರತೀಯ ದೇವಾಲಯ ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪದ ತೊಟ್ಟಿಲು ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಇಲ್ಲಿ 120ಕ್ಕೂ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಚಾಲುಕ್ಯ ದೇವಾಲಯಗಳಿವೆ.
summary_hi: ऐहोले को भारतीय मंदिर वास्तुकला का पालना कहा जाता है; यहाँ 120 से अधिक चालुक्य मंदिर हैं।

name: Pattadakal
description: Pattadakal is a UNESCO World Heritage Site on the banks of the Malaprabha river with a group of nine Hindu temples and a Jain sanctuary that blend the northern Nagara and southern Dravida styles.
history: Pattadakal was the coronation place of the Chalukya kings in the 7th and 8th centuries. The Virupaksha Temple was built by Queen Lokamahadevi around 740 CE to celebrate her husband Vikramaditya II's victory over the Pallavas.
how_to_reach: Pattadakal is 22 km from Badami. Taxis and local buses run from Badami; Badami railway station is the nearest railhead.
tips: The Pattadakal Dance Festival is held every January against the temple backdrop.
summary_kn: ಮಲಪ್ರಭಾ ನದಿ ತೀರದ ಪಟ್ಟದಕಲ್ಲು ಚಾಲುಕ್ಯ ರಾಜರ ಪಟ್ಟಾಭಿಷೇಕದ ಸ್ಥಳ ಹಾಗೂ ಯುನೆಸ್ಕೋ ವಿಶ್ವ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ತಾಣ.
summary_hi: मलप्रभा नदी के तट पर स्थित पट्टदकल चालुक्य राजाओं का राज्याभिषेक स्थल और यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल है।

name: Belur
description: Belur is home to the Chennakeshava Temple, a masterpiece of Hoysala art with intricately carved soapstone figures of dancers (madanikas), elephants and scenes from the epics. It is part of the UNESCO-listed Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas.
history: The Chennakeshava Temple was commissioned by King Vishnuvardhana in 1117 CE to mark his victory over the Cholas and took 103 years to complete. Belur was an early capital of the Hoysala Empire.
how_to_reach: Belur is 38 km from Hassan and 220 km from Bengaluru. Hassan is the nearest railway station; KSRTC buses connect Belur, Halebidu and Hassan.
tips: Hire a government-approved guide to understand the stories carved on the walls. Combine with Halebidu, just 16 km away.
summary_kn: ಬೇಲೂರಿನ ಚೆನ್ನಕೇಶವ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಹೊಯ್ಸಳ ಶಿಲ್ಪಕಲೆಯ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಉದಾಹರಣೆ; ಮದನಿಕೆಯರ ಶಿಲ್ಪಗಳು ವಿಶ್ವಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: बेलूर का चेन्नकेशव मंदिर होयसल शिल्पकला का अद्भुत उदाहरण है; यहाँ की मदनिका मूर्तियाँ विश्वप्रसिद्ध हैं।

name: Halebidu
description: Halebidu, the old Hoysala capital Dwarasamudra, is known for the twin-shrined Hoysaleswara Temple whose outer walls carry thousands of finely carved friezes of animals, gods and epic stories.
history: Construction of the Hoysaleswara Temple began around 1121 CE. The city was sacked twice by the armies of the Delhi Sultanate in the 14th century, after which it came to be called Halebidu, meaning 'old capital'.
how_to_reach: Halebidu is 31 km from Hassan and 16 km from Belur. Regular buses and taxis connect the three towns.
tips: The museum on the temple lawns is small but worth 20 minutes.
summary_kn: ಹೊಯ್ಸಳರ ಹಳೆಯ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ ಹಳೇಬೀಡಿನ ಹೊಯ್ಸಳೇಶ್ವರ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಕೆತ್ತನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: होयसलों की पुरानी राजधानी हलेबीडु का होयसलेश्वर मंदिर हज़ारों बारीक नक्काशियों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Shravanabelagola
description: Shravanabelagola is one of the most important Jain pilgrimage centres, home to the 57-foot monolithic statue of Gommateshwara (Bahubali) atop Vindhyagiri hill, reached by about 620 rock-cut steps.
history: The statue was commissioned by Chavundaraya, a minister of the Western Ganga dynasty, around 983 CE. Tradition holds that Emperor Chandragupta Maurya spent his last years here as a Jain monk. The Mahamastakabhisheka ceremony is held once every 12 years.
how_to_reach: Shravanabelagola is 145 km from Bengaluru and 51 km from Hassan. Channarayapatna (13 km) is the nearest major town with bus links.
tips: Climb barefoot early morning or late afternoon - the granite steps heat up by noon. Socks are allowed.
summary_kn: ವಿಂಧ್ಯಗಿರಿಯ ಮೇಲಿರುವ 57 ಅಡಿ ಎತ್ತರದ ಗೊಮ್ಮಟೇಶ್ವರ ಏಕಶಿಲಾ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಶ್ರವಣಬೆಳಗೊಳದ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಆಕರ್ಷಣೆ.
summary_hi: विंध्यगिरि पर स्थित 57 फुट ऊँची गोमटेश्वर (बाहुबली) की एकाश्म प्रतिमा श्रवणबेलगोला का मुख्य आकर्षण है।

name: Srirangapatna
description: Srirangapatna is an island town on the river Kaveri that served as the capital of Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan. It is dotted with monuments such as the Daria Daulat Bagh summer palace, the Gumbaz mausoleum and the ancient Ranganathaswamy Temple.
history: Tipu Sultan, the 'Tiger of Mysore', ruled from Srirangapatna and fell defending its fort against the British in the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War in 1799. The Ranganathaswamy Temple dates back to the 9th century Ganga period.
food: Mandya ragi mudde with naati koli saaru
how_to_reach: Srirangapatna lies on the Bengaluru - Mysuru expressway, 125 km from Bengaluru and 16 km from Mysuru, and has its own railway station.
tips: Easily combined with Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary (4 km) and Brindavan Gardens on a Mysuru trip.
summary_kn: ಕಾವೇರಿ ನದಿಯ ದ್ವೀಪ ಪಟ್ಟಣ ಶ್ರೀರಂಗಪಟ್ಟಣ ಟಿಪ್ಪು ಸುಲ್ತಾನನ ರಾಜಧಾನಿ; ರಂಗನಾಥಸ್ವಾಮಿ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಮತ್ತು ದರಿಯಾ ದೌಲತ್ ಇಲ್ಲಿವೆ.
summary_hi: कावेरी नदी का द्वीप नगर श्रीरंगपटना टीपू सुल्तान की राजधानी था; यहाँ रंगनाथस्वामी मंदिर और दरिया दौलत बाग हैं।

name: Bidar Fort
description: Bidar Fort is one of the most formidable forts of the Deccan, with Persian-style palaces, a triple moat and the Rangin Mahal decorated with mother-of-pearl inlay. Bidar town is also the home of the famous Bidriware metal craft.
history: Ahmad Shah Wali of the Bahmani Sultanate moved his capital from Gulbarga to Bidar in 1427 and rebuilt the fort. Later it became the seat of the Barid Shahi dynasty.
how_to_reach: Bidar is 690 km from Bengaluru but only 140 km from Hyderabad. It has a railway station and a small airport with limited flights.
tips: Visit a Bidriware workshop in the old town to see artisans inlay silver into blackened alloy.
summary_kn: ಬಹಮನಿ ಸುಲ್ತಾನರ ಬೀದರ್ ಕೋಟೆ ಪರ್ಷಿಯನ್ ಶೈಲಿಯ ಅರಮನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಬಿದ್ರಿ ಕಲೆಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: बहमनी सुल्तानों का बीदर किला फ़ारसी शैली के महलों और बिदरी शिल्प के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Gol Gumbaz
description: Gol Gumbaz in Vijayapura is the mausoleum of Sultan Mohammed Adil Shah and has one of the largest domes in the world. Its Whispering Gallery echoes even a soft whisper several times.
history: Completed in 1656, the monument was designed by Yaqut of Dabul. Vijayapura (Bijapur) was the capital of the Adil Shahi dynasty, which left behind many fine monuments including the Ibrahim Rauza.
how_to_reach: Vijayapura is 520 km from Bengaluru and connected by overnight trains and buses. The monument is 2 km from the railway station.
tips: Reach the gallery right at opening time when it is quiet - the echo effect works best without crowds.
summary_kn: ವಿಜಯಪುರದ ಗೋಲ ಗುಮ್ಮಟ ವಿಶ್ವದ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಗುಮ್ಮಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು; ಇದರ ಪಿಸುಗುಟ್ಟುವ ಗ್ಯಾಲರಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧ.
summary_hi: विजयपुरा का गोल गुंबज दुनिया के सबसे बड़े गुंबदों में से एक है; इसकी व्हिस्परिंग गैलरी प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Chitradurga Fort
description: Chitradurga Fort, also called Kallina Kote (stone fortress), sprawls across granite hills with seven concentric walls, secret passages, temples and water tanks.
history: The fort was developed by the Nayakas of Chitradurga between the 15th and 18th centuries. It is famous for the legend of Onake Obavva, a guard's wife who defended the fort single-handedly with a pestle against Hyder Ali's soldiers.
how_to_reach: Chitradurga is 200 km from Bengaluru on NH 48 (about 3.5 hours). Frequent buses run from Bengaluru and Hubballi.
tips: The fort involves a lot of climbing over rocks; wear good shoes and carry a cap.
summary_kn: ಏಳು ಸುತ್ತಿನ ಚಿತ್ರದುರ್ಗದ ಕಲ್ಲಿನ ಕೋಟೆ ಒನಕೆ ಓಬವ್ವನ ಶೌರ್ಯದ ಕಥೆಗೆ ಹೆಸರುವಾಸಿ.
summary_hi: सात दीवारों वाला चित्रदुर्ग का पत्थर का किला ओनके ओबव्वा की वीरता की कहानी के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

name: Bangalore Palace
description: Bangalore Palace is a Tudor-style royal residence modelled on Windsor Castle, with fortified towers, carved wooden interiors and a large collection of royal photographs and paintings.
history: The palace was built in 1878 by Chamarajendra Wadiyar X and is still owned by the Mysore royal family. Its grounds host many of the city's concerts and exhibitions.
how_to_reach: The palace is in the heart of Bengaluru, 5 km from Majestic and 30 km from Kempegowda International Airport.
tips: Camera and mobile photography tickets are charged separately.
summary_kn: ವಿಂಡ್ಸರ್ ಕೋಟೆಯ ಮಾದರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು ಅರಮನೆ ಮೈಸೂರು ರಾಜಮನೆತನದ ಟ್ಯೂಡರ್ ಶೈಲಿಯ ಅರಮನೆ.
summary_hi: विंडसर कैसल की तर्ज़ पर बना बैंगलोर पैलेस मैसूर राजपरिवार का ट्यूडर शैली का महल है।

name: Somanathapura
description: Somanathapura's Chennakeshava (Keshava) Temple is a perfectly preserved star-shaped Hoysala temple with three shrines standing on a raised platform, admired for its lathe-turned pillars and detailed friezes.
history: The temple was consecrated in 1268 CE by Somanatha Dandanayaka, a general of Hoysala king Narasimha III. In 2023 it was inscribed by UNESCO as part of the Sacred Ensembles of the Hoysalas.
how_to_reach: Somanathapura is 38 km east of Mysuru. Take a taxi from Mysuru; it combines well with Talakadu and Shivanasamudra.
tips: The temple is compact - one to two hours is enough; ideal as a half-day trip from Mysuru.
summary_kn: ಸೋಮನಾಥಪುರದ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಾಕಾರದ ಕೇಶವ ದೇವಾಲಯ ಹೊಯ್ಸಳ ವಾಸ್ತುಶಿಲ್ಪದ ಸುಂದರ ಮಾದರಿ.
summary_hi: सोमनाथपुरा का तारे के आकार का केशव मंदिर होयसल वास्तुकला का सुंदर नमूना है।
